content.title: About
content.content: Potato French fries with cheese are deep‑fried potato sticks topped with melted cheese. The dish is popular in fast‑food restaurants and is often served as a snack or side.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The first French‑fries recipe appeared in France in the late 19th century.
Cheese sauce is usually made from cheddar, mozzarella or processed cheese.
In the United States, cheese‑topped fries are commonly known as “cheese fries” and are a staple in sports bars.
There are many variations: with bacon, chili, sour cream, and green onions.
French fries are one of the most consumed fast‑food items worldwide.

items.title: Energy source
items.content: Potatoes are rich in carbohydrates that quickly provide the body with energy.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Potatoes contain vitamins B6 and B9, important for metabolism.

items.title: Potassium
items.content: Potassium helps maintain normal blood pressure and heart function.

items.title: Calcium and phosphorus from cheese
items.content: The cheese topping adds calcium and phosphorus, supporting bone health.

items.title: Protein
items.content: Cheese increases the protein content, beneficial for muscle maintenance.

items.title: High calorie content
items.content: Fried potatoes and cheese make the dish calorie‑dense; portion control is recommended.

items.title: Saturated fats
items.content: Cheese contains saturated fats, which can raise cholesterol levels if consumed in excess.

items.title: Sodium
items.content: Salt is often added for flavor, which may be a concern for people with hypertension.

items.title: Milk allergy
items.content: Individuals allergic to dairy proteins should avoid this product.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the fries hot, sprinkling extra cheese, green onions or spices on top. Common accompaniments include ketchup, mayo, or sour cream.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Best enjoyed immediately. Leftovers should be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for 1‑2 days and reheated in the oven to retain crispness.
